name: Ezra
overview: The book of Ezra highlights the pivotal role of Ezra, a skilled scribe and priest, who was commissioned by King Artaxerxes to lead a group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem. Demonstrating a heart committed to seeking and teaching the law of the LORD, Ezra not only read and upheld the Mosaic statutes but also instituted spiritual reforms, including appointing a fast to seek God's guidance. His leadership was marked by royal support, enabling him to restore proper worship and moral order among the returned colonists.
